Site Induction System Guide

How workers and contractors submit a safety induction, how EHS reviews, approves or rejects it, and how a worker ends up with an active site pass. Step-by-step tutorials with flow diagrams first, the full screen-by-screen reference after.

App: twswzvv3ark.feishu.link/app/app_4kc3md809u3z2 Public form: …/apply Written for the live version of 9 Nov 2026

    How an induction moves

    Four ways in, one review queue, one pass. The status names below are exactly what the screens show.

    Induction lifecycle
    flowchart LR
  subgraph IN["Ways in"]
    A["Worker app: Submit Induction"]
    B["Public form /apply"]
    C["Feishu Base form"]
    D["Admin: New Induction"]
  end
  A --> P
  B --> P
  C --> P
  D -->|"Submit Induction"| P
  D -->|"Submit and Approve"| AP
  P(["PENDING"]) -->|"Approve"| AP(["APPROVED: awaiting attendance"])
  P -->|"Reject with a reason"| R(["REJECTED"])
  P -->|"Reject, Fraudulent document ticked"| FB(["REJECTED and BLOCKED"])
  R -->|"Worker: Edit and Resubmit"| P
  FB -->|"EHS: Unblock, Lift Block"| R
  AP -->|"Mark attendance"| AC(["ACTIVE: site pass and QR"])

  AC -->|"Serious violation"| RI(["REINDUCTION REQUIRED"])

  RM -->|"Reinstate"| RI
    Pending · under review Approved · awaiting attendance Active · pass issued Rejected Reinduction required Removed from site
    Campus rightsOnly the assigned and backup reviewers of a record's campus (from its Project/Block, e.g. KVTP-A) can approve, reject, mark attendance or lift a block. Every other admin can view it. The reviewer names are listed in Tutorial D.
    No automatic messagesThe app does not send a message when an induction is approved or rejected. Workers with an account check My Status & Pass. EHS can send one by hand with Notify in Worker Records (app-account workers only).

    AWorker with an app account

    For workers and contractor staff who will log in to the app themselves. The company on the account is chosen at registration (currently the list has EPG only).

    From registration to site pass
    flowchart TD
  S1["Register at /signup"] --> S2["Ask EHS for a 6-digit code"]
  S2 --> S3["First login: username, password and code"]
  S3 --> S4["Fill in Submit Induction"]
  S4 --> S5["My Status: PENDING"]
  S5 --> S6{"EHS decision"}
  S6 -->|"Approved"| S7["Attend the safety briefing on the induction date"]
  S7 --> S8["ACTIVE: site pass with QR"]
  S6 -->|"Rejected"| S9["Read the reason, fix, Edit and Resubmit"]
  S9 --> S5

    1. Register

    1. Open the app link and tap Register here on the login page (or go to /signup).
    2. Fill in Full Name (as per passport), Username, Email, Password and pick your Company from the list.
    3. Tap Create Account. You are sent to the login page with: "Account created! Get your 6-digit verification code from the EHS department, then log in."
    Password rulesA new password needs at least 10 characters (12 for Admin and EHS Admin accounts), with a capital letter, a small letter and a special character (e.g. ! @ # $). It cannot be a common password or the same as the username. Passwords made before 9 Nov 2026 keep working. 5 wrong passwords for one username on one device lock that username on that device for 15 minutes. Too many sign-ups from one network (30 in 15 minutes) show "Too many sign-ups, try again later".

    2. First login with the EHS code

    1. On Username & Password, enter your username and password and tap Sign In.
    2. The first time, an EHS Verification Code box appears. Ask the EHS office for a code (they generate it on their Accounts page).
    3. Type the 6 digits and tap Verify & Sign In. You see "Account verified. Welcome!" and land on Submit Induction.
    4. From then on, username and password are enough.
    About the codeEach code works once and expires 24 hours after EHS creates it. After 10 wrong codes in 15 minutes the device is paused for 15 minutes. Older accounts, or accounts not made on the registration page, cannot use a code: the login says "This account must be verified by the EHS department" and EHS presses Verify instead.

    3. Submit the induction

    1. Open Submit Induction in the menu.
    2. Fill in your identity (name, passport number and expiry, nationality, date of birth), permit expiry, CIDB expiry, trade, Position, Campus then Block, and an emergency contact.
    3. Upload the passport, work permit, CIDB green card and a clear face photo. These positions also need a competency certificate: Competent Person, Operator, Electrician (Wireman), Welder, Scaffolder, Rigger / Signalman, Crane / Lifting Operator, Safety & Health Officer, Excavator, Forklift and MEWP operators, Chargeman and Cable Jointer.
    4. Tap Submit Induction. The form auto-saves a draft every 30 seconds, so you can come back later.
    Auto-fill and photo checkWhen you upload the passport or IC, the app reads it and fills in empty fields only. Those fields show "Filled from document - please check": check them. The CIDB and work permit expiry dates are also read from their uploads. The face photo is checked: a photo that is blurry, too dark, too bright or too small is refused, so take it again. Rename a file if its name has a comma, a quote mark or a backslash.

    4. Follow your status

    1. Open My Status & Pass. PENDING means EHS is reviewing.
    2. APPROVED — Awaiting Attendance: attend the safety briefing on the induction date and sign the sheet. Bring your original passport/IC and CIDB card.
    3. ACTIVE: your site pass and QR code appear. Security can scan the QR to check you.
    4. REJECTED: read the reason, tap Edit & Resubmit, fix and send again.
    Blocked numberIf an application is rejected as a fraudulent document, the screen only says to contact the EHS department, and the passport/IC number cannot be used to apply again until EHS lifts the block.

    5. Change or forgot your password

    1. To change it, tap the key icon (Change password) next to the logout button at the bottom of the sidebar. This is for username and password accounts only.
    2. Enter your Current password and a New password that follows the password rules above, then tap Change Password.
    3. Your old password stops working at once and your other devices are signed out. After 5 wrong current passwords, changing is locked for 15 minutes.
    4. Forgot it? The login page says: "Forgot password? Contact the EHS department to reset it." EHS sets a new one for you.

    BContractor or worker without an account

    The public Apply for Site Induction page needs no login and works on a phone. A supervisor can fill it in for a worker. EHS can share the link or a printable QR from Pending Reviews (Share application link).

    Public form
    flowchart LR
  A1["Open /apply link or QR"] --> A2["Fill in 6 sections"] --> A3["Tick the declaration, Submit Application"] --> A4["Keep the WF- reference"] --> A5["EHS reviews and approves"] --> A6["Attend the briefing and sign"] --> A7["Pass and card issued"]
    1. Personal & ID. Choose Passport or MyKad / IC. MyKad holders are fixed to Malaysian, need a 12-digit IC; the work permit is optional.
    2. Employment. Pick the Company (EPG), type the Trade, choose the Position, then Campus and Block.
    3. Emergency contact (required) and Supervisor (optional).
    4. Documents & expiries. Passport, work permit and CIDB expiry dates; competency certificate details if your position needs one.
    5. Upload documents. Passport/IC copy, work permit copy, CIDB green card copy and a worker photo. Photos or PDF, max 10 MB each (the worker photo must be a JPG, PNG or WEBP image, not a PDF).
    6. Tick I confirm the information provided is true and complete. and tap Submit Application. Write down the reference number shown (it starts with WF-).
    Auto-fill and photo checkAfter you upload the passport or IC, the form reads it and fills in empty fields only (it never overwrites what you typed). These fields show "Filled from document - please check", so check each one. The CIDB card and work permit expiry dates are read from their uploads too. The worker photo is checked: blurry, too dark, too bright or too small photos are refused; take a new one in good light. On some Chrome browsers the form also checks that a face is in the photo. If a file name has a comma, a quote mark or a backslash, rename the file first.
    No status pagePublic-form applicants have no login, so they cannot see their status in the app and the app cannot message them. The supervisor should check with the EHS office using the WF- reference.

    CEHS admin: review to site pass

    Daily work for reviewers. Use the Campus picker in the sidebar to choose which campus you see. It never changes what you are allowed to do.

    1. Give a worker their first-login code

    First-login verification code
    flowchart LR
  C1["Worker registered"] --> C2["Worker asks EHS"] --> C3["Accounts page: Generate Code"] --> C4["Give the 6 digits: once, 24 h"] --> C5["Worker logs in with the code"] --> C6["Account verified"]
    1. Open Accounts. In First-Login Verification Codes, type who it is for (optional) and click Generate Code.
    2. Read out or copy the 6 digits. The list shows each code as Unused, Used (by whom), Expired or Revoked. Revoke stops an unused code.
    3. Alternative: click Verify on an Unverified account so the worker can log in with just a password.

    2. Review, approve or reject

    Review decision
    flowchart TD
  R1["Pending Reviews: open a record"] --> R2{"Your campus?"}
  R2 -->|"No"| R3["View only"]
  R2 -->|"Yes"| R4["Check documents, CIDB check, Document check"]
  R4 --> R5{"Decision"}
  R5 -->|"All good"| R6["Approve: Induction Date, Inducted By, Badge ID"]
  R5 -->|"Something wrong"| R7["Reject: write the reason, AI Suggest optional"]
  R5 -->|"Fake or altered document"| R8["Reject and tick Fraudulent document"]
  R6 --> R9["APPROVED: awaiting attendance"]
  R7 --> R10["Worker sees the reason and can resubmit"]
  R8 --> R11["Number blocked everywhere"]
    1. Open Pending Reviews. Pending records are listed first, then approved ones waiting for attendance. Filter by campus and company.
    2. Click a record. Check the photo, details, Work Authorization expiry cards (VALID / EXPIRING / EXPIRED) and the documents. The AI Audit Suggestion is advice only.
    3. CIDB check: the CIDB check box looks up the worker on CIDB CIMS and shows Valid until (date), Expired, Not found in CIDB or CIDB unreachable. It also says whether the CIDB expiry the worker entered Matches CIDB. The answer is kept for 7 days; click Re-check to ask CIDB again (Retry when CIDB was unreachable).
    4. Document check: click Run document check. The app reads the uploaded passport / IC, CIDB card and work permit and compares the name, ID number, date of birth, passport / CIDB / permit expiry and CIDB card number across the documents, the form and CIDB. It is advice only: you still decide.
    5. To approve: click Approve, set Induction Date (the briefing day), Inducted By and optionally Badge / Worker ID, then Confirm Approval.
    6. To reject: click Reject, write the Rejection Reason (the worker reads it; AI Suggest can draft it), then Confirm Rejection.
    7. Many at once: tick rows and use Batch Approve (today's date, you as inductor) or Batch Reject (one reason for all).

    3. Fraudulent document block

    Block and unblock
    flowchart LR
  F1["Reject with Fraudulent document ticked"] --> F2["Number blocked on the app, /apply, Base form and New Induction"]
  F2 --> F3["Applicant only sees: contact the EHS department"]
  F3 --> F4["EHS: Worker Records, Unblock, reason, Lift Block"]
  F4 --> F5["Worker can Edit and Resubmit"]

    Tick Fraudulent document — block this passport / IC from applying again in the reject dialog. Spaces, dashes and letter case are ignored when numbers are compared. Only the campus reviewers can lift the block from Worker Records with Unblock → reason → Lift Block.

    4. Attendance and the site pass

    Briefing day
    flowchart LR
  T1["Attendance: pick the date"] --> T2["Print sign-in sheet"] --> T3["Workers sign with pen"] --> T4["Tick who signed"] --> T5["Mark selected as attended"] --> T6["ACTIVE: pass and QR"] --> T7["Print cards"]
    1. Open Attendance, choose the Induction date, optionally the venue and trainer, and click Print sign-in sheet (A4 landscape, signature column).
    2. After the briefing, tick the workers who signed and click Mark selected as attended, then Confirm attendance. Each becomes ACTIVE with a verify code (VP-…).
    3. For one worker, Mark Attendance in Pending Reviews does the same.
    4. Print the cards. On the same Attendance page, tick the attended workers (or click Select all attended) and click Print cards (N). Up to 100 cards go in one job; click Select all attended again for the next 100. Workers who already have a card are skipped: reprint those one by one from Worker Records. For a single worker, open them in Worker Records and click Print Card.
    5. In the print window, use Browser Print (card printer, scale 100%, no margins) or Open in Magicard HUB (.card). One-time setup on each PC in Chrome: after the first download, open the menu of the .card file in Chrome's downloads and choose "Always open files of this type". Then the file opens straight in Magicard HUB.
    About the cardEach worker has one card. The front shows no campus or block (the top line is blank). The QR on the back opens the live verify page for that card, and the back shows "Card issue no. N". The first card is issue no. 1.

    Change block

    Use this when an approved or active worker moves to another campus or block. Reviewers of both the old and the new campus can do it. Edit can no longer change the block of approved or active records.

    1. In Worker Records, open the worker and click Change Block.
    2. Pick the new Campus and Block, add a Note (optional), and click Change Block.
    3. The card stays valid, no reprint is needed: scanning the QR shows the new block. The Activity Log records "moved from X to Y".

    Lost or damaged card

    1. In Worker Records, open the worker and click Print Card.
    2. The window says the worker already has a card. Under Reason for reprint (required), choose Lost, Damaged or Other (Other if the last print was cancelled and no card came out). Add a note if needed.
    3. Print. The new card gets the next issue number. The old card now scans as "Card replaced - do not accept this card".
    Cards printed before numberingA worker whose card was printed before card numbers started may still hold that old card, so their first numbered card also needs a reprint reason.

    5. Violations and re-induction

    Violation levels and removal
    flowchart LR
  V1["Log violation"] --> V2{"Level"}
  V2 -->|"Warning"| V3["Stays ACTIVE"]
  V2 -->|"Serious"| V4["REINDUCTION REQUIRED"]
  V4 -->|"Complete Reinduction"| V3
  V1 -->|"4th violation"| V5["REMOVED FROM SITE"]
  V5 -->|"Reinstate"| V4
    1. Log a violation on Reinduction with Log Violation, or straight from a card scan (section 6). Choose the Level: Warning (default, the worker stays authorised on site) or Serious (the worker must be re-inducted before returning; status REINDUCTION REQUIRED).
    2. Add evidence if you have it: up to 20 photos or PDFs per incident, 10 MB each. You can also click Add evidence later on the incident. Only admins can see evidence.
    3. After the re-induction session, click Complete Reinduction with the date and who conducted it. The worker is ACTIVE again with the same pass.
    3 strikes: removed from siteEach worker can have 3 violations. The 4th (counted since the last reinstatement) makes the worker NOT AUTHORIZED and removed from site automatically. The passport / IC number is then blocked on every way in (app, /apply, Base form, New Induction). Worker Records and Reinduction show a Warnings: n of 3 badge. Violations logged before 9 Nov 2026 do not count toward the 3.
    1. To reinstate: a reviewer of the worker's campus opens the worker in Worker Records and clicks Reinstate.
    2. Write the Reason for reinstating (required) and click Reinstate.
    3. The worker becomes REINDUCTION REQUIRED and must be re-inducted before returning. The history is kept and the count restarts at 0 of 3.

    6. Scan a card at the gate / log a violation from the scan

    Anyone can scan the QR on the back of the card with a phone camera. No login is needed. The verify page shows:

    • Photo, name, company and position, and a big AUTHORIZED or NOT AUTHORIZED with the reason.
    • ID number with the last 4 digits hidden (e.g. 890101-14-••••), Authorized site (campus - block), induction date, Current card, and passport / permit / CIDB validity.
    • Warnings: n of 3. An old card shows "Card replaced - do not accept this card". A removed worker shows "Removed from site".
    1. EHS admin: scan the card on a phone signed in with Lark. A Log violation panel appears under the details. Not signed in? Tap "EHS admin? Sign in with Lark to log a violation".
    2. Choose the Level (Warning or Serious), the Violation type, write the Description and check Reported by.
    3. Under Evidence (optional), tap Take photo to use the phone camera, or attach photos / PDFs (up to 20).
    4. Tap Log violation. If this is the 4th violation, the panel warns first that the worker will be removed from site.

    7. Violation Log

    1. Open Violation Log in the sidebar (admins). It lists every violation by the date it happened.
    2. Filter by From / To date (default: the last 30 days), Block, Type, Level, Company and Reported by. Reset clears the filters.
    3. The totals show Violations, Warnings, Serious and Workers removed.
    4. Click Export CSV to download the filtered list.
    Activity LogThe Activity Log now also records block changes, workers removed and reinstated, evidence added, card issues and password changes. Its actor filter lists staff only.

    DEHS admin: setup

    One-time and occasional settings.

    Accounts

    • Create Custom Account: username, password, full name, company and role (Worker, EHS Admin, Admin). Only an Admin can create Admin or EHS Admin accounts; an EHS Admin can create Worker accounts only. Accounts made here can log in straight away.
    • Reset sets a new password (use it when someone forgot theirs). An EHS Admin can reset worker accounts only; an Admin can reset anyone. New passwords follow the password rules in Tutorial A (12+ characters for Admin and EHS Admin). Disable logs the person out and blocks login (records are kept); Enable restores access. Nobody can disable their own account.
    • EHS staff should sign in with Sign in with Lark (no app password needed); who counts as admin is set by IT on the server.

    Companies

    The approved list drives every company field (Register, /apply, New Induction, account and worker edits). It currently holds EPG only. Add more with Add, rename or Deactivate them; with no active company the fields go back to free text.

    Card Settings

    Per campus (KVTP, NTP, BTP and a default): the Emergency Contact, EHS Officer and Project Manager printed on the back of the card, and the switch for the verify QR.

    New Induction (on someone's behalf)

    Same form as /apply inside the admin area. A reviewer of that campus can tick Approve now and use Submit & Approve to skip the queue; the record gets an ADMIN tag and an AD- reference.
